clues.text: When the LORD rained sulfur and fire on Sodom, his wife looked back and became a pillar of salt.
After his herdsmen quarreled with Abram's herdsmen, he chose the well-watered plain of the Jordan for himself.
Four kings carried him off from Sodom, and Abram chased them with 318 trained men to rescue him.
Sitting in the gateway of Sodom, he welcomed two angels into his house and baked them unleavened bread.
Told by angels to flee Sodom to the mountains, he begged to escape to a small nearby town instead.
His two daughters bore sons named Moab and Ben-ammi, fathers of the Moabites and the Ammonites.
Peter calls him a righteous man, tormented by the lawless deeds he saw while living in Sodom.
